name: laravel-agents
description: Specialized Laravel subagents — laravel-backend, sql-database, api-architect, pest-tester, code-reviewer-laravel, security-auditor, performance-optimizer — plus four companion skills (wame-laravel-standards, wame-package-development, wame-security-checklist, wame-performance-playbook). The agents are thin personas that defer to progressively-disclosed reference skills instead of inlining examples: API response format, database conventions (ULID, enums, sort, dateTimeTz, data via migrations not seeders), service layer, testing patterns, clean composer package/module creation per laravelpackage.com (with stubs + composer.json path-repository wiring), OWASP Top 10 security checks, and a performance playbook. A shared cross-cutting quality reference (UI/UX, performance, security, page reachability — every new screen gets a menu entry and inbound links — and framework: the current idioms of the installed Laravel/PHP/Pest versions, detected from composer.lock and looked up via Laravel Boost search-docs or context7) is applied while building by laravel-backend and pest-tester and reviewed by code-reviewer-laravel under the same keys teamwork-task-test uses, framework as advisory recommendations. Two work modes: fast (the brief says so or .claude/work-mode.local.md says mode: fast) skips tests, Pint, docs lookups, the self-check and browser work and ends with a Deferred checks line; full (default) keeps every rule — /work-mode full from the work-mode plugin runs the deferred checks once. Nova-free by design — for Laravel Nova install laravel-nova-agents alongside.
